description: A soak buys time for someone else to hit the bug first; its length is how long the ecosystem
needs to absorb a breaking release and the vendor needs to ship a regression patch. All
release-age policy lives here; this preset is extended closest to LAST in renovate.json:
minimumReleaseAge is a plain scalar, so the last matching rule wins, and the two rules below
that remove a soak must beat every earlier setter (the shared preset's per-update-type ladder,
override-calver's flat 14 days). Keep this entry last in extends; add new release-age rules
here so nothing earlier silently outranks them.
Coder ships stable and experimental releases on one channel, and a release only counts as
stable after roughly a month, so the soak reconstructs that unpublished stable channel.
